blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine Blu Girls were beaten handily by host Japan, 10-0, in four innings to start their medal bid in women’s softball at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Saturday. The Blu Girls surrendered nine runs in the second inning before the game held at Anjo Softball Ground concluded after the bottom half of the fourth due to a 10-run mercy rule.
